# David Packer Requires Holding A Static Position Before Training The Dynamic Version For Planche And Front Lever

David Packer requires that you need to be able to hold a static position like a planche or front lever before you start training the bent-arm dynamic version of that movement. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- To be able to push out of a position you need to be able to hold that position first. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- You need to have the front lever down and the planche down before you can do front lever pull-ups or planche push-ups. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- When somebody cannot hold a full planche and they start trying to do planche push-ups, they start bobbing and cannot lock out. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Evidence

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "to be able to push out of a position you need to be able to hold that position right so that's like a it's a step below being able to lift your whole body out of you know to lock out"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "a bent dynamic is um being able to hold the movement isn't a prerequisite you have to be able to hold that movement before you start training the bent dynamic so you need to have that front lever down you need to have the planche down so that you can push out or pull up"
